ghcr.io/oreondev/harbor-mcp:0.1.1.overview:
## Harbor MCP Server

A read-only MCP server for Harbor, the open-source container registry. It lets AI assistants answer questions about a running Harbor: projects and quotas, repositories and artifacts, vulnerability scan results, robot accounts and members, replication health, webhooks and garbage collection. None of the tools changes anything in Harbor, and credentials, robot secrets and webhook authorization headers never appear in tool results.

Run it as a read-only Harbor robot account; the permissions are documented in the repository (`docs/read-only-robot.json`).
